description.value:
Range touch

Targets 1 willing ally

Duration until the end of your next turn

You press an Ember into an ally's hand, still warm. Choose one reaction you have that requires or uses an Ember. Until the end of your next turn, that ally may use that reaction once, using your modifiers, and you cannot use it yourself while the Ember is out of your hands. The Ember returns to you when the duration ends or when the ally uses the reaction, whichever comes first — it goes cold and finds its way back. Your Ash-Light cannot be in an Ember you hand over.

cinderfall.incomplete: This grants an ally a temporary sense/capability or lets an ally use the caster's own reaction with the caster's own modifiers, sourced from the caster's own class feature. No selector or rule element exists anywhere in pf2e-source for granting an ally a buff/sense/action from this actor's own item or ability -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass, and even more specific here (lending an action with the lender's own modifiers is a step beyond the already-confirmed absence).
